scenario_metadata.vulnerability_type: Heap-based Buffer Overflow (CWE-122) in netframed port 8443

steps.title: Threat Intelligence Alert & Telemetry Ingress
steps.rationale: Correct statutory application: Legal awareness requires confirmation of both a product vulnerability AND active exploitation in the wild (Article 14(2)).

steps.title: Lead CSIRT Statutory Jurisdiction Determination
steps.rationale: Correct: Article 14(7) establishes jurisdiction based on the manufacturer's Main Establishment. CSIRT-IE coordinates with affected CSIRTs (BSI, ANSSI) via ENISA SRP.

steps.title: Article 14(2)(a) 24-Hour Early Warning & Delayed Dissemination
steps.rationale: Correct: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/881 empowers manufacturers to request delayed dissemination to protect systemic cybersecurity during patch engineering.

steps.title: CVD Intake Coordination & Ethical Researcher Safe Harbor
steps.rationale: Correct: ISO/IEC 29147 standard practice; preserves legal safe harbor, coordinates disclosure date, and protects customers.

steps.title: Article 14(8) Proportional Customer Security Advisory
steps.rationale: Correct: Article 14(8) mandates proportional user notification providing actionable mitigations without assisting malicious attackers.

steps.title: Hotfix Engineering, Upstream Sharing (Art 13(6)) & Final Report
steps.rationale: Correct: Fully satisfies Annex I Part II(2) free updates, Article 13(6) upstream sharing, Annex I Part II(6) CSAF advisories, and Article 14(2)(c) Final Report.
